title: THE LEAKED FILES 📂
topic: Exposing school secrets via mass leak

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: THE TIMER JUST HIT ZERO, and every phone in this building [beat] is about to explode with the principal’s darkest secrets!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Wait, you don't understand, if my dad sees those altered test scores [beat] he’s going to literally pull me out of this school today!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Nix, put that phone down right now or I will make sure you are expelled [beat] before the first file even finishes uploading!

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: It’s too late, my screen just lit up with a PDF titled [beat] 'The Faculty Bribe List', and Mister Kamal’s name is right at the very top!

lines.speaker: kamal
lines.text: That is a total fabrication and a complete invasion of my privacy [beat] which will lead to immediate legal action for everyone involved!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Privacy doesn't exist when you're using school funds to pay off your gambling debts [beat] and we have the digital receipts to prove every cent!

lines.speaker: riku
lines.text: Guys, look at page forty-two, there’s a hidden folder about the school's cafeteria [beat] and it says the meat isn't even graded for humans!

lines.speaker: ding
lines.text: I knew those mystery nuggets tasted like cardboard, but this says [beat] they’ve been serving us expired rations from the late nineties!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Turn off the Wi-Fi immediately, I want every single student [beat] to hand over their devices to the front office right this second!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: You can’t stop the signal now, Principal Huda, because I didn't just send it to the students [beat] I CC'd the entire local news department!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: As the hallways descended into total chaos, Nix noticed one encrypted file [beat] that wasn't supposed to be part of the leak.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait, why is there a photo of my own house and my mom [beat] inside a folder labeled 'The Real Project' in the principal's private drive?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: You thought you were the one doing the spying, Nix [beat] but you have no idea how deep this rabbit hole actually goes for your family!
